note: How loud should the sky be in the water's mirror? Weighed in the 72nd session, on the start camera, with `node tools/bands.js --labels foot,middle,far <the pictures> 350,600,900,646 350,545,900,595 350,505,900,540`. No sky at all reads L127, L146, L147 — and the foot is full of facets down at L16-31, which is the fault being chased. Strength 0.6 reads L137, L157, L160. SHIPPED strength 1 reads L142, L163, L166, with nothing in the foot below L98: that is where the water's own foot comes level with the coping's dry stone, which reads L143. Strength 1.2 reads L145, L166, L170 and strength 2 reads L153, L176, L181, past which the near half of the pool is the colour of weak tea. A steeper payment was tried first — the sky at the SQUARE of the Fresnel, on the theory that only the facets which edge the eye really mirror — and at strength 2 it bought two points over the plain law, which is nothing, so the plain law was kept and the second dial was thrown away with it. `tools/waterskydown.json` is the same dial weighed where the eye looks down into the pit instead of along it.

cases.name: no sky in the mirror (the control)
